vehicle_reference.car_base_definition: car chassis center on the ground plane (z = 0). On v05 the robotic arm base (joint_1 axis) is at this same point.
vehicle_reference.layout_axis_convention: Tag centers and rotations are expressed in the car body frame: origin = chassis center on ground = arm base, x right, y forward, z up.

0.orientation_note: 相机实测朝车尾、侧贴：印面右朝下、印面上朝车右；对应名义面内旋转 -90°。

1.orientation_note: 相机实测朝车尾、正贴，印面上朝上；对应名义面内旋转 0°。
